plan.intro: Search once, compare every way to travel, then book every leg with one payment.

trips.connect: Connect your wallet to see your booked trips
trips.emptyBody: Search a route and tap “Book whole trip”. Your trips will show up here.
trips.paid: Paid ≈ {usdc} USDC · {pax, plural, one {# passenger} other {# passengers}}
trips.alert: Rain chance up to {prob}% {kind, select, transfer {during your transfer} walk {during your walk} other {on your ride}} at {name}. Consider leaving {min} min earlier.

tickets.connect: Connect your wallet to see your tickets
tickets.emptyBody: Every leg you book is kept as a ticket in your wallet and shown here.
tickets.qrBody: Let staff scan this when you board. The QR is confirmed by your wallet and only works for the ticket holder.
tickets.noRefund: The refundable cancellation window has passed.
tickets.transferBody: Send ticket {label} to your friend's wallet. They become the ticket holder instead of you.
tickets.transferHint: Starts with 0x, 42 characters. Double-check it: this can't be undone.

profile.timeValue: Value of your time (used by “Best value”)
profile.timeValueHint: One hour saved is worth {price} to you
profile.connect: Connect your wallet to see your balance and get test money
